description: REC-10: classify BC sales-order External Document No. against the Portal customer PO over a bounded BC-first sample (recent BC documents per company joined to the served Portal replica by the BC order number; GET only). Passes only on a finding compared with a served Portal order (summary.portal_compared); BC-only findings (summary.bc_only) never count; blocked (source_gap) when the replica holds none of the Portal-dependent orders or no sampled document is Portal-dependent. Records counts per class only, no values.
notes: Label live-unverified until a live run records it. Portal facts come from the source mirror (po_reference, custom_fields.custPoCode, app_shipment.shipment_code); FM custpocode and Sage ponumber are not read. Sampling is BC first (2026-10-08: the ten newest replica orders were never drained to BC, none_found 10/10, because the staging Portal app drains BC Production from plx-postgres-uat while the reporting API serves the staging replica): up to --limit BC documents per company, newest first (salesOrders orderDate desc, salesInvoices invoiceDate desc). Classes BC alone settles are reported first for every sampled document, before any replica read: a blank External Document No. is blank, and a sales order whose value equals its own number is matches_order_number/equals_bc_document_number (Portal and BC carry the same order number, align-portal-so-number.ts@d07f912:1-12); bc_sample.by_class counts documents per class (blank, matches_order_number, portal_dependent, unknown). Only portal_dependent documents are joined to app_sales_order.order_number by the BC order number (salesOrders number, salesInvoices orderNumber), never by the External Document No. under test. A BC document with no order number is unknown/bc_document_without_order_number, one whose number fails the BC literal grammar unknown/order_number_invalid. A BC order number the replica does not hold is unknown/not_in_served_replica (bc_sample.not_in_served_replica counts them). Which companies hold a held number (R10-2) comes from one listing of the order-number field per company (at most 5 pages of 1000), not one lookup per order and company; a company whose listing is incomplete (bc_sample.index_incomplete) gets the per-number lookup, so BC GETs at --limit 10 over 3 companies are 3 samples, up to 5 index pages per company (one page while a company holds at most 1000 numbers; the index is read only when the replica holds a sampled number) and one lookup per held number (at most 30) plus one per held number and company whose listing is incomplete: at most 48 with complete listings (36 when every listing fits one page; 93 before the index); bc_sample.bc_requests records them, token requests included. A sales order's BC orderDate and Portal order_date are compared as calendar days, each in its own zone (the serializer writes orderDate as the UTC day of the Portal instant, serializers.ts@4243499:1100-1105): a Portal timestamp without a zone is read as UTC, its real zone, since app_sales_order.order_date is a Prisma DateTime without @db.Timestamptz (portal/prisma/schema.prisma@a8d54b1:3972, SalesOrder.orderDate), Postgres timestamp(3) without time zone holding the UTC instant Prisma writes; another day is unknown/order_date_conflict, a non-date or a BC value that is not a plain date unknown/order_date_not_comparable. BC order identity is a number lead (find_by_number), never asserted. With --entity-set salesInvoices each invoice is classed by authorship first (summary.invoice_authorship): portal_possible (invoice date before the 2026-10-03 TASK-2271 cutover, a lower bound with the deploy date unevidenced; or an entity-map row; lenient, never unrelated), bc_native (entity-map read and no row, date on or after the cutover) or unknown. app_bc_entity_map is not served, so a post-cutover invoice stays unknown here, never a mismatch. Only a Portal comparison passes: summary.portal_compared >= 1 counts findings classified (any class but unknown or blank) against a served Portal order's customer-PO, order-number and shipment evidence; summary.bc_only counts the findings BC alone settled (blank, or a sales order whose value equals its own number) and never counts as a Portal comparison (2026-10-15: the check passed on BC-only findings with 0 Portal joins). When the run needed the replica for at least one BC order number and the replica held none of them (all_not_in_served_replica true, expected while BC Production is drained from UAT), the check is blocked with cause source_gap (blocked_when blocked = not_in_served_replica), never a pass. When no sampled document is Portal-dependent (every finding bc_only, every company read, none withheld; no_portal_dependent_document true), no Portal comparison was possible: the check is blocked with cause source_gap (blocked = no_portal_dependent_document), never fail and never pass, until the served replica serves BC-drained orders (later_ask workbench-api-replica-target). A run with Portal-dependent documents that compares none and is not all_not_in_served_replica fails. summary.unknown_reasons names why (not_in_served_replica: the BC order number is absent from the served replica, expected while BC Production is drained from UAT; none_found: no BC company holds it any more; order_date_conflict, order_date_not_comparable, order_number_invalid, company_read_incomplete, ambiguous_across_companies, shipment_numbers_not_read, no_po_like_portal_candidate, ...). Live live-2026-10-20T22:37:28Z (results/latest.json): 20 orders, bc_sample.in_served_replica 0, not_in_served_replica 17 (3 blank), no_portal_dependent_document false because no finding was comparable; the run reads blocked with cause source_gap (upstream business-central not_in_served_replica, blocked since 2026-10-08), typed not failed: the cause is the served replica lacking BC-drained orders (later_ask workbench-api-replica-target), not the selection (the sample takes the newest 20 BC orders and 17 carry an external document number), so the assertion stays.
